audience: CMS authors copying published-content REST requests

context.availability: Publication metadata is informational; never promise a request was executed or access verified. Legacy snapshots require republish.
context.fields: Labels are translated; JSON field names, GET, JSON and executable code remain protocol syntax.
context.comingSoon: No dates, scripts or SDK imports. REST works through the API.
context.hosts: Folder/card/editor hosts consume the same request engine. Integrations never saves or publishes; root needs a persisted folder. Details is the default editor panel.
context.validation: Inline polite messages tied to their field. Bounds use locale-aware numbers and explicit item/character units; never show validator internals.

security.secretPolicy: Never interpolate credentials, raw errors or URLs into translated messages.
security.linkPolicy: Workspace Admin URL is built from the existing safe origin allowlist.
